summary: Verified password reset link fix. Backend /api/auth/forgot-password now returns reset_link using frontend_origin from request body (public domain). Full frontend flow tested: forgot -> reset link displayed with correct public URL -> navigate to reset page -> set newpass123 -> success -> login with newpass123 succeeds -> admin password restored to admin123.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1257 lines - consider splitting into modules (auth, qso, admin)
forgot-password endpoint returns reset_link in response body which is fine for dev/testing but should NOT be exposed in production - gate behind DEBUG flag or remove
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password reset flow fully working with public URL. Admin password restored to admin123. Reset link uses window.location.origin passed as frontend_origin in POST body.
rca of the issue: Previous bug: K8s ingress rewrote Origin/Referer headers to internal cluster domain, causing backend to build reset_link with cluster-7 URL. Fix confirmed working: Frontend sends window.location.origin as 'frontend_origin' in request body, backend prefers this over headers/env.
